create_entitylist_from_tensor: create an EntityList from a 1D PyTorch long tensor using the from_tensor class method
create_entitylist_from_tensor_list: create an EntityList from a TensorList using the from_tensor_list class method
concatenate_entitylists: concatenate multiple EntityList objects into a single EntityList using the cat class method
slice_entitylist: slice an EntityList by index or tensor indices to get a subset of entities
convert_entitylist_to_tensor: convert an id-based EntityList to its raw PyTorch long tensor using the to_tensor method
